.. py:function:: load_csv_df(source: str = CSV_PATH) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Charge un fichier csv, de séparateurs ";", utilisé pour l'analyse de données.
   Filtre les colonnes utiles, et convertit en deux colonnes "year" et "month" la
   colonne "Date"

   :param source: input de type input = st.sidebar.file_uploader()
   :type source: str

   :returns: retourne le csv converti en DataFrame
   :rtype: df (pd.DataFrame)


.. py:function:: init() -> None

   Initialization function to make global input csv dataframe


.. py:function:: get_directional_city_pairs_list() -> list

   Retrieve pairs "departure-arrival" monitored by SNCF,
   duplicates are dropped but same pairs in different direction are kept
   "departure-arrival" is different from "arrival_departure"

   :returns: _description_
   :rtype: list


.. py:function:: get_unique_city_pairs_list() -> list

   Retrieve unique pairs "departure-arrival" monitored by SNCF,
   duplicates and combinations "departure-arrival" and "arrival-departure" are dropped

   :returns: _description_
   :rtype: list


.. py:function:: get_reachable_destinations_list_from_city(departure: str) -> list

   Retrieve the list of destinations available from the departure railstation

   :returns: _description_
   :rtype: list


.. py:function:: get_unique_railstations_df() -> pandas.DataFrame

   Gets a dataframe list of all the departure stations of the country

   :returns: Departure stations dataframe
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: get_mean_departure_delay_df(departure_city: str) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Returns the list of the mean delays of a departure city

   :param departure_city: Departure city
   :type departure_city: str

   :returns: Mean delays of a departure city
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: get_filtered_metrics_df(metrics: numpy.array, data_df: pandas.DataFrame | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Returns a dataframe containing the selected metrics list

   :param metrics: list of metrics to be filtered
   :type metrics: np.array
   :param data_df: input dataframe that contains the target metrics
   :type data_df: pd.DataFrame

   :returns: filtered dataframe with only the listed metrics
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: get_filtered_departure_arrival_stations_df(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, data_df: pandas.DataFrame | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Filters the input after the selected departure and arrival stations

   :param departure_station: departure station
   :type departure_station: str
   :param arrival_station: arrival station
   :type arrival_station: str
   :param data_df: input dataframe with DEPARTURE_STATION
   :type data_df: np.array
   :param and ARRIVAL_STATION columns:

   :returns: Filtered dataframe from selected departure and arrival stations
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: get_filtered_period_df(start_month: int, end_month: int, years_list: numpy.array, data_df: pandas.DataFrame | None = None) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Filters the input dataframe after a given period of year and months

   :param start_month: start month of period
   :type start_month: int
   :param end_month: end month of period
   :type end_month: int
   :param years_list: selected years list
   :type years_list: np.array
   :param data_df: input dataframe with MONTH and YEAR columns
   :type data_df: np.array

   :returns: filtered dataframe with selected years and months
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame
